exam_facts.note: Two-part knowledge exam (physical p5, printed p3): part one = 10 traffic-sign questions, all ten must be answered correctly before part two; part two = general-knowledge multiple choice, at least 80% correct to pass. Handbook states no part-two question count and no time limit.

handbook_edition: No edition date stated; issuer form DMV 39
